el.Show en vivo para tu fiesta: clásicos de: Live show for your party: Luis Miguel and Marc Anthony classics and plenty of dancing.
el.Soy Abel y canto en vivo para que tu eve: I'm Abel, and I sing live to make your event a night to remember. I love how music can take you on a trip through time, with classics by Luis Miguel, Marc Anthony and songs that go straight to the heart.
el.También armo sets para levantar cualquie: I also put together sets to get any dance floor moving: cumbia, cuarteto, reggaeton and bachata. Energy and good vibes for private parties and events of all kinds.
el.Hay canciones que van directo al corazón: Some songs go straight to the heart.
